GenSC-6G - Scalable Semantic Communication Framework and Dataset
	

This repository contains the first semantic communication dataset and playground, designed to be scalable, reproducible, and adaptable for a wide range of applications. The dataset and framework are tailored for semantic decoding, classification, and localization tasks in 6G applications, integrating generative AI and semantic communication.
